extracted.intended_audience: French learners, students, writers, word-game players, lexicographers and language professionals
extracted.subtask_description: A product/feature overview for Le Robert Online Dictionary describing the content types, coverage and tools the site offers to help users learn, research, and play with French. Useful for evaluating the dictionary's scope and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: 145,000 regularly updated definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: The site provides 145,000 definitions which are regularly updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied quality metric: breadth and currency of headword definitions; regular updates support modern usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: 200,000 synonyms, arranged by meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: A database of 200,000 synonyms organized by sense/meaning rather than simply listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organization by meaning aids precise synonym selection and disambiguation between senses.

rubrics_metrics.name: audio pronunciation of all words
rubrics_metrics.description: Pronunciations (audio) are available for all words in the dictionary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports spoken-language learning and correct pronunciation practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 6,500 conjugation tables
rubrics_metrics.description: The dictionary includes 6,500 verb conjugation tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides morphological reference for verbs across tenses and moods; useful for learners and writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: 85,000 collocations (combinations of words frequently appearing together)
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage of 85,000 collocations showing common word pairings and multiword expressions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps users learn natural phrasing and multiword patterns; important for fluency and translation accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: millions of examples in context, taken from press articles, scientific texts, works of literature or official documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive example sentences and usages drawn from a wide variety of corpora and genres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual examples illustrate register, usage, and nuance across domains; supports reliable sense disambiguation.

rubrics_metrics.name: all the grammar and spelling rules you need to make sustainable progress
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive presentation of French grammar and orthography rules intended to support learning progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Functions as a compact grammar/orthography reference for learners seeking systematic improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: historical definitions taken from the 17th-century Dictionnaire universel de Furetière to illustrate the evolution of the language over the centuries
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes historical senses and definitions sourced from older dictionaries to show diachronic change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for etymological insight, literary studies, and understanding historical usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: word games
rubrics_metrics.description: Interactive games and tools (Scrabble aid, mots fléchés, mots croisés, Motus, Mot le plus long, etc.) to assist with wordplay and vocabulary practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to engage users and support informal learning and puzzle solving.

rubrics_metrics.name: regularly updated blog with features on words and expressions, language Top 10s, podcasts and more
rubrics_metrics.description: A blog offering editorial content, lists, podcasts and features about words and expressions, updated regularly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides interpretive and cultural context, highlights trends, and deepens user engagement with language topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trending words / Most searched lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists showing most-searched words, conjugations, and synonyms over recent periods (e.g., last 7 days).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reflects current interest and usage trends; useful for discovery and monitoring evolving vocabulary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Word of the day
rubrics_metrics.description: A daily featured word (mot du jour) presented to users to promote vocabulary learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational engagement tool encouraging regular exposure to new or interesting vocabulary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Le Robert Correcteur, La Certification Le Robert and Grand Robert et Collins
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional product offerings and services (spelling/grammar corrector, certification, bilingual Grand Robert et Collins) linked from the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates complementary professional and learner-facing tools and paid resources for deeper research or formal assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional content via Petit Robert / Grand Robert subscriptions (etymology, literary quotations, more detailed definitions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscribers (Petit Robert / Grand Robert) gain access to expanded scholarly content such as etymologies, literary quotations, and more detailed definitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes free vs. subscription tiers; signals that advanced/academic research features are behind subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Games with daily challenges (Chronomots, Le Décodeur, Alphamo)
rubrics_metrics.description: Daily timed/limited-challenge word games (find words in 2 minutes, guess mystery words in 6 tries, anagram puzzles with constraints).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides structured daily practice and gamified vocabulary challenges to increase retention and engagement.
